item.description: - Coming back from a notification or a group with ⌘[ puts the keyboard back on the list - ⌘F focuses the search field, and Escape leaves it for the list again - The About window and the Contacts prompt are in Japanese too

- Threads group exactly as on the iPhone: a group chat by its members, so a renamed group stays one thread, using the subtitle, sender, and recipients the iPhone now sends - The same notification seen by both devices no longer appears twice when Spark fills in a subject line the iPhone leaves empty - If Notification Center's database goes missing, as it can after the disk runs full, Karui says so instead of blaming Full Disk Access, and picks it up again on its own - Return opens the selected notification or group, and ⌘[ goes back a level

- Threads are grouped the way Karui for iPhone's History groups them: email threads by subject without the "Re:", Slack channels by name, X posts by their text, chats by the group's name or the person - Apps, Senders, and Threads are tables now: sort by any column, drag columns to reorder or resize, and the layout is remembered
